2	Training on recursively generated data leads to irreversible quality degradation (\emph{model collapse})~\citep{shumailov2024model}.

- q03 epoch-matched PPL=17.74 > q05 epoch-matched 17.65

Table~\ref{tab:detector} compares three detector families for adaptive reweighting.
The discriminative TF-IDF+LR detector produces the only improvement over uniform; both generative perplexity detectors degrade performance.
